description: This header file declares the API for a vector of integers, including initialization, creation, addition, search, removal, and destruction functions.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes the integer vector data structure.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes the integer vector with a specified number of entries and initial value.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a number to the integer vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds a number in the integer vector and returns its index.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a number from the integer vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_RemoveUnusedEntries
methods.description: Removes unused entries from the vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Deallocates resources associated with the vector.
